description:
Preflight or execution result from `archlens reproduce`. This is a DERIVED, explicitly non-authoritative output (plan section 3.3). It carries an independent format version and must never be read back as measurement evidence.

1.1 exists because 1.0 predated fields the command already emits, while declaring `additionalProperties: false` — so every real invocation violated the schema that claimed to describe it. Nothing validated the output, so the drift was invisible. The emitted payload is the intended interface; 1.0 is retained unchanged as historical material and is not the current contract. (finding F-P3-9)

assurance_state.description: exact_environment_ready is impossible when the original run lacks a real profiler commit SHA (plan section 16.2).

execution_attempted.description: Whether execution was actually attempted. Preflight is read-only by contract and always reports false.

execution_error.description: Why execution failed, or null when it did not fail.

network_used.description: Whether the network was actually used, as observed rather than as authorized. Distinct from network_authorized on purpose.

output_root_created.description: Whether reproduction created its output root.

reproduction_run_directory.description: Directory of the reproduction run, or null if none.

reproduction_status.description: Terminal status of the reproduction run, or null.

wrote_anything.description: Preflight writes nothing (plan section 16.4). Execution reports its isolated output root separately.

title: ArchLens reproduction output 1.1
